engine.calibrated_on: 2023-24 held-out simulation: durK 1.058 (possessions per team 98.5 vs 98.8 actual), tot_off 2.15 (mean total 2.15 above actual before the offset), h1s 0.038 (first-half share of points 0.4945 vs 0.5004 actual; 0.064 gave 0.5043)

rest.note: Back-to-back (margin only) improved 2024-25 (margin RMSE 14.024 -> 13.967, moneyline 0.5959 -> 0.5930) but not 2025-26 (14.263 -> 14.263, 0.5831 -> 0.5844), so it is off. Rest of 3+ days, travel and time zones were not significant on 2021-24 and are off.

props.note: Dispersions chosen on 2024-25; markets kept only if they beat both baselines on 2025-26. Rebounds beat them on log loss but ran 5 points high on overs and had a worse average error than the season average, so they are off.

tables.title: Before launch: held-out season test
tables.note: Every game rated only on earlier games (refit daily). 2024-25 was used to choose settings; 2025-26 was untouched until the end. Log loss, lower is better; RMSE in points. Model only, no market input. The model beats the simple baselines everywhere but not the closing market: at DraftKings' closing spread and total it does worse than a coin flip, so on Pinnacle-priced games use the anchored numbers.

tables.title: What was kept
tables.note: Each addition kept only if it improved held-out predictions. Margin RMSE / moneyline log loss, closed-form test.
rows: Simulation matched to the ratings' closed form

tables.title: Before launch: player props
tables.note: 2025-26, every player-game rated on earlier games only; players who played (props are void otherwise). Lines: book-style (season average rounded down + 0.5) plus fixed lines. Baselines price the same lines from the player's season-to-date or last-10 average. Log loss over all lines, lower is better.

notes.foot: Data: ESPN play-by-play and box scores via the sportsdataverse hoopR releases; injuries and expected lineups from RotoWire; prices from Pinnacle (no-vig). Fair prices are the simulation's probabilities with no margin. Model details and test results: README in nba-sim-data.
